profile.reading:
This Lumen colocation facility is located at 1757 Old Meadow Road, McLean, VA 22102, one of two adjacent Lumen buildings on Old Meadow Road (the other at 1755, also tracked in this registry), part of the broader Tysons/McLean data center and telecommunications corridor near Washington, DC; Lumen does not publish individual building addresses or specs on its own site for any of its 175-plus North American colocation sites. Lumen Technologies, formerly CenturyLink (renamed Lumen on September 14, 2020, with its stock ticker changing from CTL to LUMN on September 18, 2020) and built in part on CenturyLink's November 1, 2017 acquisition of Level 3 Communications, operates this facility as part of a network-centric edge colocation product rather than a wholesale hyperscale campus. Lumen's own colocation data sheet states more than 175 carrier-neutral data centers across more than 60 North American markets, offering cabinet power in the 3 to 15 kilowatt range described as varying by site; unlike the wholesale operators tracked elsewhere in this registry, Lumen does not disclose per-building square footage or total MW capacity for any of its sites.

Virginia's data center boom is reshaping statewide electricity rates directly relevant to every Northern Virginia facility. In November 2026, the Virginia State Corporation Commission approved new Dominion Energy rates that will raise a typical residential bill by about $16 a month to roughly $165, while creating a new GS-5 rate class specifically for data centers effective January 1, 2027; regulators approved $775.6 million of the roughly $1.2 billion Dominion sought, cutting about $350 million tied to speculative data center projects, according to Inside Climate News.

The Tysons/McLean corridor has long served as a network interconnection hub for the Washington, DC metro, predating much of the newer hyperscale build-out further west in Loudoun County; Lumen's two adjacent Old Meadow Road buildings reflect that older, carrier-hotel-style pattern of data center development.

reading.body:
Lumen McLean in McLean, Virginia is a facility operated by Lumen Technologies at 1757 Old Meadow Road. The operator has not published power capacity, rack count, or cooling specifications for this campus. No dedicated facility page was found during research.

Without published specifications, the campus cannot be ranked among Virginia's data centers by power capacity. Virginia has 326 mapped facilities and 23 with published power figures totaling 1,375 megawatts. This facility would rank twenty-fourth by published capacity if one were disclosed, meaning at least twenty-three other facilities in the state have larger published ratings.

The research status is complete but constrained by what Lumen has made public. Whether this McLean location is part of Lumen's retained colocation business or traces to assets divested in 2017 cannot be determined from published sources. Until capacity is disclosed or independently confirmed, this facility's significance to AI scaling cannot be assessed from the data available.
